settings_desc.stream_heartbeat_interval_: How often an idle notification stream sends a keep-alive. The gateway idle timeout must be comfortably higher than this.
settings_desc.stream_max_buffered_events: How far a slow client may fall behind before its stream is closed. It reconnects and replays what it missed.
settings_desc.web_enabled: Deliver notifications to the web application. Turning this off does not stop notifications being recorded; they remain readable in the inbox.
